reason: Ivan asked to draft a RAG engine using e-means instead of k-means and to revise rather than replace the B9 plan; the answers (revise B9, wherever-needed clustering, borrow ragflow patterns, phased draft only) are durable scoping rules for this domain, and no existing skill covers RAG planning.

Skill says self-hosted embedding/reranking is out of Phase 1, but ruling E1 (2026-11-16) makes local models the required path. Also the agent recommended a hosted reranker without reading ADR-0003 and was corrected; the skill should tell the next session to read the ADR first.

The kick-off gate ("waits on Stage 10.4 and 10.9 plus P1 to P5") is superseded by ruling E4. Add the rule that plan cards must be cold-probed for executor choices, because Ivan asked for plans that need no extra reasoning.

The proven-DDL step is a repeatable way to make a schema card executable with zero design choices. The episode used it and it caught nothing the card needed, but it removed the schema from the design space for the executing agent. The skill did not yet say it.

The skill already says to read the governing ADR before recommending a vendor, but the episode shows the check stopped at the first ADR the grep found. A later ADR (0003) overruled a recommendation the user had already ruled on. Patch the existing rule to require checking for newer ADRs.
